manifest.author: LLM supervisor (session of Issue #25)
manifest.created_at_checkpoint: non-study smoke run (seed 999) step 3100, before registration
manifest.purpose: Explain WHY a pooled persistent edit of the declared mass block fails while the block is causally sufficient: decompose editability into pooled-affine, per-route-affine and copy-target-mean components.
manifest.hypothesis: H1 route-specific (non-additive) mass code: per-route affine edits succeed where pooled fails. H2 curved code within a route: per-route affine fails but copying the route-specific target class mean succeeds. H3 block not sufficient alone: copy fails.
manifest.read_scope: model copies (safetensors); training-pool force examples (ctx.observe.fit_pool) for fitting; development force examples of pretraining families for scoring; never sealed
manifest.measurement_definitions: intended = share of eligible examples (answers for edited mass, edited acceleration and unedited all distinct) whose prediction equals the answer computed with the edited mass; edits act on h[0:16] only, routes are (mass unit) x (phrasing family) cells; affine maps are least-squares fits on training-pool examples

manifest.author: LLM supervisor (session of Issue #25)
manifest.created_at_checkpoint: after registration commit 921a8d6, during study pretrain; validated and first run on non-study smoke checkpoints (seed 999)
manifest.purpose: Reconcile block-swap IIA (1.0) with exemplar-copy success (~0.55, T001) by stratifying swap success over source/base attributes.
manifest.hypothesis: H-style: the fit-pool sources include word-number and abbreviated-unit surface forms that pretraining never showed (PRETRAIN_LESSON has no style); their block codes are off-distribution. Prediction: canonical-style sources >= 0.9, non-canonical-style sources markedly lower. Competing: H-pool (train vs dev tuples) or H-family (cross-family) explain the gap instead.
manifest.read_scope: model copies; dev-tuple force examples of the given families; ctx.observe.fit_pool; never sealed
manifest.measurement_definitions: swap success = argmax of head(h_base with h[0:16] replaced by h_src[0:16]) equals M_src*A_base*S_base mod 13; only pairs whose target differs from the base answer are scored; bases are canonical style (digits, full units)
